properties.description: Master orchestration pipeline for the banking AI log analytics platform. Executes the full medallion-architecture data flow: bronze ingestion → silver transformation → gold build, each as a child ExecutePipeline call in strict sequence. Wraps each stage in an Until activity that polls for completion with a configurable timeout, enabling decoupled async execution. Sends a Logic App webhook notification on overall success or failure. Intended to be triggered manually or by a high-level daily/event schedule.

activities.name: set_batch_id
activities.description: Derives and stores a canonical batch_id from process_date for use across all child pipelines.

activities.name: ep_bronze_ingest
activities.description: Executes pl_bronze_ingest as a synchronous child pipeline. Passes the derived batch_id, process_date as ingestion_date, and source system. Waits for completion before proceeding to silver.

activities.name: set_bronze_status_succeeded
activities.description: Records bronze pipeline completion in the orchestrator-level status variable.

activities.name: set_bronze_status_failed
activities.description: Records bronze pipeline failure so downstream activities can react without inspecting child pipeline state directly.

activities.name: web_notify_bronze_failure
activities.description: Sends an immediate failure alert to the Logic App webhook when the bronze pipeline fails, so operations teams are notified before silver is attempted.

body.value: @json(concat('{"orchestrator_run_id":"', pipeline().RunId, '","pipeline_name":"pl_master_orchestrator","failed_stage":"bronze","batch_id":"', variables('batch_id'), '","process_date":"', pipeline().parameters.process_date, '","status":"FAILED","failed_at":"', utcnow(), '","message":"Bronze ingestion stage failed. Silver and Gold stages will not run."}'))

activities.name: until_bronze_complete
activities.description: Until activity that polls the bronze_status variable. Exits when bronze_status is no longer PENDING or RUNNING. The Until body is a no-op Wait that allows the condition to be re-evaluated on each iteration. In practice bronze runs synchronously via waitOnCompletion=true, so this loop exits on the first iteration; it is included as the required pattern for decoupled async orchestration and timeout safety.

activities.name: wait_bronze_poll
activities.description: Polls every poll_interval_seconds seconds before re-evaluating the Until condition.

activities.name: ep_silver_transform
activities.description: Executes pl_silver_transform after bronze completes successfully. Passes the same batch_id and process_date for data lineage consistency.

activities.name: set_silver_status_succeeded
activities.description: Records silver pipeline success.

activities.name: set_silver_status_failed
activities.description: Records silver pipeline failure.

activities.name: web_notify_silver_failure
activities.description: Sends a failure alert to the Logic App webhook when the silver transformation pipeline fails.

body.value: @json(concat('{"orchestrator_run_id":"', pipeline().RunId, '","pipeline_name":"pl_master_orchestrator","failed_stage":"silver","batch_id":"', variables('batch_id'), '","process_date":"', pipeline().parameters.process_date, '","status":"FAILED","failed_at":"', utcnow(), '","message":"Silver transformation stage failed. Gold build will not run. Check silver quality validation output."}'))

activities.name: until_silver_complete
activities.description: Until activity that polls silver_status. Provides the timeout safety net and async decoupling pattern. Exits when silver_status resolves to SUCCEEDED or FAILED.

activities.name: wait_silver_poll
activities.description: Polls every poll_interval_seconds seconds.

activities.name: ep_gold_build
activities.description: Executes pl_gold_build after silver completes successfully. Passes batch_id, process_date, and the Logic App webhook URL so the gold pipeline can send its own targeted notification.

activities.name: set_gold_status_succeeded
activities.description: Records gold pipeline success.

activities.name: set_gold_status_failed
activities.description: Records gold pipeline failure.

activities.name: until_gold_complete
activities.description: Until activity that polls gold_status. Provides timeout safety net with a 4-hour ceiling for the gold build stage.

activities.name: wait_gold_poll
activities.description: Polls every poll_interval_seconds seconds.

activities.name: set_orchestrator_status_success
activities.description: Sets the master orchestrator status to SUCCESS once all three medallion layers have completed.

activities.name: web_notify_orchestrator_success
activities.description: Sends a master-level success notification to the Logic App webhook once all three stages complete. Includes a summary of all stage statuses and the derived batch_id for traceability.

body.value: @json(concat('{"orchestrator_run_id":"', pipeline().RunId, '","pipeline_name":"pl_master_orchestrator","batch_id":"', variables('batch_id'), '","process_date":"', pipeline().parameters.process_date, '","status":"SUCCESS","bronze_status":"', variables('bronze_status'), '","silver_status":"', variables('silver_status'), '","gold_status":"', variables('gold_status'), '","completed_at":"', utcnow(), '","message":"Full medallion pipeline completed successfully. Gold layer is ready for BI and AI consumption."}'))

activities.name: web_notify_orchestrator_failure
activities.description: Sends a master-level failure alert if the gold build or gold status variable update fails. Complements the stage-level failure notifications for a complete alerting picture at the orchestrator level.

body.value: @json(concat('{"orchestrator_run_id":"', pipeline().RunId, '","pipeline_name":"pl_master_orchestrator","batch_id":"', variables('batch_id'), '","process_date":"', pipeline().parameters.process_date, '","status":"FAILED","bronze_status":"', variables('bronze_status'), '","silver_status":"', variables('silver_status'), '","gold_status":"FAILED","failed_at":"', utcnow(), '","message":"Master orchestrator FAILED at gold build stage. Gold data is stale. Investigate Synapse Monitor run ID: ', pipeline().RunId, '."}'))
